items: Half a head of cauliflower, chopped into florets
Only show up on the recipe homepage

steps: Preheat your oven to 200°C, and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Place the cauliflower florettes on the tray, coat with EVOO and any spices you'd like.
Roast for 15 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Roughly chop the carrots, garlic and onion.
Place cauliflower, carrot, garlic and onion into a food processor and blitz to desired consistency - not a paste!.
Heat 3 Tbsp of EVOO in large Dutch oven on a medium high heat, then toss in the blitzed mixture with a squeeze of lemon.
Cook for 5 minutes until fragrant - it shouldn't get too charred.
Add lentils, stir to coat, then add in bay leaves and stock.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer with the lid slightly ajar for 20-40 minutes.
Check the mixture every 10 minutes and top off with water so the lentils remain submerged, ensure nothing is sticking and salt levels are right.
Once cooked, optionally blend with a stick blender to reach a smoother consistency.
Serve warm with bread, a squeeze of lemon and a dollop of yoghurt.

notes: You can skip pre-roasting the cauliflower if you'd like, I haven't tried it, but I'm sure it's fine 😼
If you ARE pre-roasting the cauliflower, you may want to blitz this separately from the other ingredients and toss it in a little later, but before the lentils.
